question: Can a press started during a fault arrive after clear through the debounce delay and set the proposed single flip-flop?
method: One timed counterexample with 50 ms debounce, within candidate 20 to 80 ms range; not vendor transient simulation
stop_condition: Evaluate delayed press once; if enabled without a fresh physical action reject single-FF implementation equivalence
criteria: A press begun while faulted must not enable after fault clears without healthy release and new press
